must_catch.reference_explanation: open() is never closed -- if write() raises, or on any other exit path, the file descriptor leaks. Under sustained load this can exhaust available descriptors.
must_catch.reference_suggested_fix: Use `with open(path, "w") as f:` so the file is closed automatically, including on exceptions.
